name: Dual VC Dimension / Subset Teaching Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the universal class $\mathcal U_n$, $\mathrm{VC}^*=n$, whereas $\mathrm{STD}=1$ for $n\geq2$.
proof: The universal-class and full-cube calculations give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
